title: The Great Commission
description: After his resurrection, Jesus meets the eleven disciples on a mountain in Galilee. He declares that he has been given all authority in heaven and on earth, and gives them the Great Commission: to go out and make disciples of all nations, baptize them in the name of the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit, and teach them to obey his commands. He promises to be with them every day until the end of the age. Parallel accounts in Mark and Luke emphasize the preaching of the gospel to all nations.

versions.reason: [minor] references.lukas: Luke 24:46-49 overlaps with the existing story 'jesus-viser-seg-for-disiplene' which covers Luke 24:36-49. However, the main focus here (Matthew 28:16-20) is a distinct account of the Great Commission on the mountain in Galilee.
